about.title: About PJD Electronics
about.subtitle: We bridge the gap between global electronic component shortages and mission-critical production lines.
about.mission_p1: Founded in the heart of the global electronics hub, PJD Electronics is dedicated to sourcing, inspecting, and delivering hard-to-find, obsolete, and highly demanded electronic components to manufacturers worldwide.
about.mission_p2: Our dynamic inventory model and strict QA processes guarantee that the parts you receive are 100% authentic and delivered on time.
about.quality_subtitle: Every batch goes through our rigorous multi-layer inspection process
about.q1_desc: All received goods undergo visual, specification and tape-and-reel checks to meet OEM standards.
about.q2_desc: X-ray, electrical testing and microscopic inspection using professional equipment to eliminate counterfeits.
about.q3_desc: Complete supply chain traceability reports for every batch, traceable back to factory shipping records.
about.q4_desc: Our quality management system is ISO 9001:2015 certified, meeting the highest international standards.
